channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Sabarimala Gold Theft: ED Freezes Assets Worth Rs 1.3 Crore After Multi-State Raids Targeting TDB Officials
item.description: The ED froze Rs 1.3 crore in assets following raids into the Sabarimala temple gold theft case.

item.title: Mid Day Meal Turns Risky: Over 43 Students Hospitalised After Suspected Food or Water Poisoning in Gujarat, Officials Order Probe
item.description: Dozens of students at a tribal residential school in Banaskantha fell ill after a midday meal, prompting hospitalisation, investigation, and renewed concerns over food and water safety in schools.

item.title: Israel Bombs Four Syria-Lebanon Border Crossings Killing Two, Injuring Nineteen Civilians: Reports
item.description: Israeli strikes on Lebanese border crossings and southern towns killed two people and injured nineteen others.

item.title: 10 Indian Army Soldiers Killed and 10 Hurt After Bullet‑Proof Vehicle Plunges Into Deep Gorge in J&K’s Doda
item.description: A bullet‑proof Army vehicle heading to a high‑altitude post skidded off the Bhaderwah‑Chamba interstate road at Khanni Top in Doda, killing 10 soldiers and injuring 10 others in a tragic accident.

item.title: Canadian Man Leaves Family, Moves in With Another Woman, Quits ₹6 Crore Job After Wife Seeks Maintenance, Court Intervenes
item.description: Singapore's court mandates a former executive pay four crore rupees after resigning to evade his family support.

item.title: PV Sindhu Scripts History, Becomes First Indian Shuttler to Reach 500 Singles Wins at Indonesia Masters
item.description: PV Sindhu makes history as the first Indian shuttler to reach 500 career wins in Jakarta.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh Bhojshala Dispute: SC Allows Hindu Worship and Friday Namaz on Basant Panchami
item.description: The Supreme Court has permitted both communities to worship at the disputed Bhojshala site on January 23, mandating separate spaces, timings, and entry routes to ensure peace.

item.title: Indore Water Crisis Persists: At Least 22 Hospitalised Weeks After Deadly Outbreak
item.description: A fresh wave of water-borne illnesses in Indore’s Mhow area has reignited concerns over civic accountability, ageing infrastructure and residents’ right to safe drinking water.

item.title: Bomb Threats Trigger Massive Security Alert at Schools in Noida, Ahmedabad Ahead of Republic Day: Reports
item.description: Schools in Noida and Ahmedabad were evacuated on Friday following coordinated bomb threats ahead of Republic Day.

item.title: UP Honour Killing Shock: 19-Year-Old, Muslim Boyfriend Found Murdered in Moradabad; Woman’s Brothers Held
item.description: An interfaith couple missing for three days was found murdered and buried in Moradabad, with police alleging an honour killing involving the woman’s brothers.
